items.title: Is Teradyne Stock Asking Too Much Of Its Test Business?
items.summary: Teradyne (TER) trades at 51.7 times trailing earnings. A multiple that high is a requirement rather than an opinion: the business has to grow into it, and you can work out how much growth that takes. The harder question is whether the calculation deserves your trust when the trailing year has been this unusual.
